correctness.rationale: For every prime p and n≥3, rank-one idempotents are uv^T with v^Tu=1, modulo p−1 rescalings. Summing over v enforces u as a rational eigenvector of frequency A, so the exact complex multiplier is p^{n−1}/(p−1) sum_{λ∈Fp} p^{mλ(A)}ζ_p^λ; cyclotomic minimal polynomial gives zero iff all eigenspace dimensions coincide. Counting invariant subspaces of specified λ and imposing A|Uλ=λI yields exact Gaussian-binomial mixed moments and finite q-binomial inversion of joint eigenspace distribution, hence exact nullity/rank for every n. For fixed p, the mixed moments converge to products and Gaussian tails dominate the inversion, yielding asymptotically independent Jλ with π(k)=Q∞p^{-k²}/Q_k², the full complex/singular pushforward law, zero atom H_p=sum π(k)^p and iterated p→∞ limit e^{-1}. Independently checked small p2 Gaussian-moment normalization and the proof of the character coefficient and joint limit; stored checks are supplemental.
